name: sadv1r-agent-tools
description: sadv1r's personal plugins for Claude Code and Qwen Code

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Session workflow tools: /retry resumes work cut off by an interruption, and the backlog skill keeps deferred work in docs/backlog/

plugins.name: offline-bento-slides
plugins.description: Create and edit Bento (.bento.html) slide decks fully offline: bundled Bento app, agent guide and gallery templates

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: Collaborative design dialogue: idea to approaches to design to plan, one question at a time

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Structured implementation planning, interactive annotation review, and autonomous plan execution

plugins.name: planning-dash
plugins.description: Live agterm dashboard for a /planning:exec run: tasks, review phases, subagents, timeline and progress log in an overlay

plugins.name: hook-logger
plugins.description: Logs every hook event's payload to ~/.claude/hooks-logs/ as JSONL, for inspecting what each event carries before writing a hook
